title: The normalization of a scheme in a normal integral scheme has integrally closed local rings
statement: Let $f:T\to X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with $T$ an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] all of whose local rings $\mathcal O_{T,t}$ are integrally closed domains, and let $\nu:X'\to X$ be the normalization of $X$ in $T$ as in [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. Then every local ring $\mathcal O_{X',y}$, $y\in X'$, is an integrally closed domain.
